avatar.$description: Avatar, AvatarGroup and AvatarBadge. Component tokens reference SEMANTIC tokens through their CSS variables, so one declaration re-themes with the document. The fallback is a neutral graphite tile — identity is carried by the initials and the accessible name, never by an invented per-user colour.

background.$description: The initials tile. The neutral interactive fill: one step off every surface in both themes, so an image-less avatar still reads as an object.

foreground.$description: Initials and the fallback icon. Secondary text, held to 4.5:1 on the fallback fill in both themes.

ring.$description: The cut-out ring that separates stacked avatars and the badge from the avatar beneath. It should match the surface the avatar sits on: the default surface covers cards, panels and tables; set this variable on a container that places avatars on another surface (the canvas, a sidebar).

corner-square.$description: The square (organisation, workspace, app) shape. A percentage rather than a ramp step so a 20px and a 48px tile read as the same shape — a fixed radius would make the small one a circle and the large one a sharp square.

background.$description: The default badge dot: Qeet 500 as a graphic (≥3:1 against the ring). Status badges (presence) pass their own status fill.

foreground.$description: An icon inside the default badge: the on-brand label, white on the Qeet Ember fill.
